_about: Public-domain Benjamin Morgan Palmer (1818-1902), Southern Presbyterian pastor of First Presbyterian, New Orleans, and theologian, for the Word Hoard: addresses and sermons (1852-1863), the memorial discourse and Life and Letters of J. H. Thornwell (1862, 1875), The Family (1876), Formation of Character (1889), The Broken Home (1891), Theology of Prayer (1894) and The Threefold Fellowship (1902), from Internet Archive scans. Includes his 1860-1861 secession sermons as historical documents. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 54 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
